name: com.pafolios/pafolios
title: Pafolios
description: Search 900+ curated designer and developer portfolios for inspiration. Public, read-only.

tools.name: search_portfolios
tools.description: Search Pafolios, a curated gallery of ~900 real designer and developer portfolio websites. Use this whenever the user asks for portfolio inspiration, examples of great designer portfolios, UX/UI/product/brand/creative designer or developer portfolio sites, or ideas for their own portfolio. Filter by free-text query, category, or tag.

query.description: Free text matched against designer name, categories and tags, e.g. "brand designer" or "minimal".

category.description: Exact category name from list_categories, e.g. "Brand Designer".

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the portfolio categories on Pafolios with counts. Use before search_portfolios to pick a valid category filter.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Get the full record for one Pafolios portfolio by slug (the last path segment of its pafolios.com URL).

tools.name: get_random_inspiration
tools.description: Get a few random, hand-picked portfolios for a "surprise me" request or to spark ideas. Prefers featured portfolios; optionally within a category.
